name: Mirza
source:
A vicious aristocrat. She is an evil woman from the bottom of her heart who has taken over the house of the husband she married.
She thinks of her daughter as a tool and wants to control the royal family by having her marry a prince.
She thinks of others as nothing more than tools in general.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1059058]Getchu[/url]]
